node.title: Structural Awareness — Meta-Existence, Evaluability and Context-Restriction Calculus
node.summary: Contenido de la fuente: 1. Terminology and the source-owned A/B/C/D boundary · 2. Four independently qualified axes · 3. SA-E1 — constraint reversal under a fixed semantic universe.

relations: Evidence that a useful capability exists may justify a bounded search, while discovery, ownership, scale-up permission and realized value remain separate questions.
Traslado propuesto de un modelo de decisión; no convertir sospecha o posibilidad en certificado de existencia.
